text: Someone set my brother on fire after pouring petrol on him in his shop because he refused to sell it to them. He died two days later in the burns ward.
My uncle's son stabbed my father many times with a knife during an argument over the shop. My father died before we could reach Jinnah hospital.
Kal raat hamare mohallay mein mere bhai ko goli maar kar qatal kar diya gaya. Wo larka pehle bhi dhamkiyan deta tha, aaj aakar seedha seene par fire kiya.
At the wedding my cousin's friend was handling a loaded gun carelessly and it went off by mistake. The bullet hit a guest and he died.
comment: Careless handling of a loaded gun = rash/negligent act, qatl-i-khata.

text: My neighbour was showing his new pistol to friends and pulled the trigger thinking the safety was on. It killed his friend sitting in front of him.
Shikar par chacha ne jhaariyon mein suar samajh kar fire kiya, wahan ek charwaha larka tha jo mar gaya.
A man stabbed my father in the stomach three times outside the mosque saying "aaj tujhe zinda nahi chhorunga". Doctors saved his life after surgery.
A man tried to throw my son off the bridge into the river after a fight. People caught him and saved my son.
Teen bandon ne meri gaari rok kar mujh par kayi fire kiye, aik goli kandhay par lagi lekin main bach gaya. Wo mujhe maarna chahte thay.
comment: Correct. Note: wound also makes offender liable for hurt; hurt label not added (limitation).

text: During a fight at the cricket ground a boy hit my son on the forehead with the bat. There is a deep cut and he had stitches.
My stepmother hit me on the forehead with a hot iron. I have a burn wound on my face.
comment: Burn on face: unclear if shajjah. Removed (see A3_review_fixes.md).

text: Parking ke jhagre mein pados wale ne meray sar par eent maar di, chhe taankay lage hain.
A man attacked me with a knife in the street and cut my arm. I got eight stitches on my forearm.
The factory supervisor hit me on my back with a belt many times. There are red marks and bruises all over my back.
comment: Bruises only = 337-L, not jurh. Rewritten with broken skin.

text: pados wale ne mote danday se bhai ki tangon par maara, X-ray mein pindli ki haddi tooti hui hai
My brothers blocked the gate of our ancestral house and stopped my mother from going in or out to the market.
comment: Could be confinement (340). Rewritten as clear restraint.

text: At the petrol pump, the staff surrounded my motorcycle and did not let me leave for an hour over a dispute of 200 rupees.
comment: Surrounding can be confinement. Rewritten as clear restraint.

text: Pul par larkon ne mera rasta rok liya aur kaha paise do warna aagay nahi jaane denge.
My employer locked me inside the godown for two days because he suspected I took money. He gave me food from the window.
my father in law locked me in the bathroom for hours after a fight, i was screaming but no one opened the door
Susraal walon ne meri behan ko ek hafte se kamray mein band kar rakha hai aur phone bhi chheen liya.
My landlord's brother came into my room and held me by the shoulders and tried to kiss me. I pushed him away.
At the college gate a group of boys surrounded my friend and one of them pulled her chador and touched her.
School van ke driver ne meri beti ko ghalat tareeqay se chhua jab baaqi bachay utar gaye.
comment: Correct. Note: s.377-B (child sexual abuse) may also apply; not in label set.

text: At the wedding, the groom's relatives caught a girl from our family, tore her clothes and made her stand outside in front of the guests.
Some men attacked my mother during a land dispute, pulled off her shalwar kameez in front of everyone in the street and beat her.
Zameen ke jhagre mein unhon ne ammi ke kapray sab ke saamne gali mein utaar diye aur maara.
A man picked up my 9 year old nephew from the bus stop and drove away. The boy's school bag was found on the road.
My ex-husband's brother picked up my 8 year old son from the tuition centre without my consent and took him to another city.
comment: Correct if the mother is the lawful guardian (custody).

text: Mera 10 saal ka beta school ke bahar se ek aadmi le gaya, guard ko kaha main iska chacha hun.
My cousin was abducted by her relatives from the hostel and they are keeping her hidden in some house so she cannot marry the man she wants.
My sister was forcibly taken by her ex-fiance's family and they are keeping her in their village secretly.
comment: Implies abduction to compel marriage (365-B). Rewritten.

text: rishtedaar meri cousin ko hostel se utha kar le gaye aur kisi ghar mein chhupa rakha hai taake wo apni marzi se shaadi na kare
A doctor in our town was kidnapped from his clinic and the gang is demanding a big ransom from his family.
A businessman friend of mine was kidnapped from the motorway and his family received a call for 1 crore ransom.
Mere shohar gaari bechne gaye thay, un logon ne unhein agwa kar liya aur 30 lakh maang rahe hain.
My motorcycle was stolen from outside my office and I found it at a scrap dealer who bought it knowing it was stolen.
Someone took my laptop bag from the university library when I left it on the chair for five minutes.
Jumme ki namaz ke dauran masjid ke bahar se meri motorcycle chori ho gayi.
Our maid stole my wife's gold bangles from the bedroom drawer and left the job the next day.
comment: Correct. Note: s.381 (theft by servant) also applies; not in label set.

text: The plumber who came to fix the pipes stole my watch from the bedroom table.
Hum shaadi par gaye thay, choron ne ghar mein ghus kar almari se zevar aur cash chura liya.
In the village someone stole our buffalo at night. When they were caught they had a rifle, saying they kept it to fire if anyone followed.
The man who took my bag from the bus stand bench had a knife hidden in his jacket, he told police he kept it ready in case someone caught him.
Chor zevar le gaye, unke paas lohay ki rod aur pistol tha agar koi jaag jata to.
The builder's men threatened to demolish my house unless I paid them 'protection money', and I paid 30,000.
A man said he would harm my children if I didn't hand over my car documents. I gave him the file and the keys.
Ek gang ne khat bheja ke 5 lakh bhatta do warna dukaan jala denge, main ne dar ke maare 2 lakh de diye.
A delivery rider was stopped at gunpoint in Johar Town and his bike and phone were taken.
At night, two men stopped my rickshaw, beat me and took all the money I earned that day.
Dukaan mein daaku aaye, mujh par gun taan kar counter se saara cash le gaye.
A gang of seven people stopped the passenger bus on the highway near Sukkur and robbed all the passengers at gunpoint.
my uncle's truck was stopped by 6 or 7 armed men in the katcha area, they took the goods and his money
Aadhi raat ko chhe hathiyar band banday ghar mein ghusay, sab ko baandh diya aur zevar, cash, phone le gaye.
My mother forgot her purse at the clinic. The receptionist kept it and spent the money.
My goats wandered into my neighbour's house. He kept them and now says they are his.
Petrol pump par mere 20 hazaar gir gaye, attendant ne utha kar rakh liye.
The godown manager sold our stored wheat bags in the market and kept the money.
The committee organiser in our mohalla collected money from 20 women and ran away with it.
Mechanic ko bike repair ke liye di thi, mahine se khud chala raha hai aur wapas nahi deta.
Police caught a man with three stolen cars that he had bought knowing they were snatched.
The scrap dealer in our area buys stolen motorcycle parts from thieves. I found my bike's engine at his shop.
Meri chori shuda mobile Hall Road ki dukaan se mili, dukaandar ne larke se bohat sasti khareedi thi aur jaanta tha chori ka hai.
A man promised to get my son admission in medical college and took 10 lakh. There was no admission.
I got a call saying I won a prize from Benazir Income Support and had to pay a fee first. I paid 15,000 and never got anything.
Property dealer ne jaali kaghzaat par plot bech diya, plot kisi aur ka nikla.
My cousin entered our agricultural land with a tractor and started ploughing it to take possession, although the court decided it is ours.
my uncle's sons jump into our orchard and pluck the fruit and abuse our workers, we told them many times not to come
comment: Plucking fruit is also theft: 379 added.

text: Dusre gaon ke log raat ko hamaray khet mein ghus kar apne maweshi hamari fasal par charatay hain.
A man entered my house pretending to be a gas meter reader and went into the bedrooms. When I asked he ran away.
Some boys jumped over the wall into our house and into the courtyard to harass my sisters.
Rishtedaar zabardasti ghar mein ghus kar drawing room mein baith gaye aur kehte hain rishta do warna nahi jayenge.
My business partner gave me a cheque for my share of profit and it bounced. He knew there was no money in the account.
The buyer of my plot gave a cheque for the last instalment, but the bank dishonoured it as the account was closed.
plot ke khareedar ne aakhri qist ka cheque diya, bank ne kaha account band hai
the imam of our area announced in front of people that my father is a liar and cheats people, its not true and our family is humiliated
Someone wrote on a wall near my shop that I sell fake medicines. It's false and has hurt my business.
ek rishtedaar jhoot phaila raha hai ke meri beti ka kirdaar theek nahi, ab uski mangni toot gayi
The boy who was harassing my sister threatened that he will throw her photos online and harm her if we complain.
A man stopped me in the street and told me that he will kill my brother because of the old quarrel.
Pados wale ne kaha agar complaint wapas na li to tumhein aur tumhare bachon ko maar dunga.
A man on the bus kept staring at me and saying dirty jokes loudly so that I would hear.
My university classmate keeps asking me to send pictures and makes sexual remarks in the group chat.
gali ke larke roz meri beti ko college jaate hue seetiyan maar kar gandi baatein karte hain
